content.overview: A Producer Company's share capital consists of equity shares only. A Member's shares should, as far as may be, be in proportion to the Producer Company's patronage.
content.glance: Section 378ZB limits a Producer Company's share capital to equity shares and links Members' shareholdings, as far as may be, to patronage.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378ZB (Share capital). The share capital of a Producer Company shall consist of equity shares only. Shares held by a Member shall, as far as may be, be in proportion to the patronage of the company. The section does not specify a fixed numerical ratio in the text summarized here. Legal verification remains open.

sections.heading: Equity shares only
sections.body: The share capital of a Producer Company shall consist of equity shares only.

sections.heading: Patronage-based shareholding
sections.body: The shares held by a Member in a Producer Company shall, as far as may be, be in proportion to the patronage of that company.

examples.title: Reviewing share-capital structure
examples.body: Check whether the Producer Company's share capital consists only of equity shares and assess Member shareholdings in light of the statutory patronage principle, allowing for the words “as far as may be”.

hypotheticals.question: A Producer Company proposes to issue a class of non-equity shares. What does section 378ZB state?
hypotheticals.analysis: Section 378ZB states that the share capital of a Producer Company shall consist of equity shares only. Separately, Member shareholdings should, as far as may be, be in proportion to the company's patronage.

distinctions.title: Equity-only capital and patronage-based holdings
distinctions.left: Section 378ZB requires share capital to consist of equity shares only.
distinctions.right: It separately states that Members' shareholdings should, as far as may be, be proportionate to company patronage as far as may be.

rows.right: Relationship between Member holdings and patronage
“As far as may be” proportionate to patronage

misconceptions.trap: Treating the equity-only rule and patronage principle as the same requirement.
misconceptions.correction: Section 378ZB states them separately: one concerns share type, the other the relationship between holdings and patronage.

misconceptions.trap: Inventing a fixed shareholding-to-patronage formula from section 378ZB alone.
misconceptions.correction: The text uses “as far as may be” and does not itself state a fixed numerical ratio.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should s. 378ZB be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. State equity-only capital. II. Apply the patronage-proportion principle. III. Conclude.

examTips: Keep share type distinct from shareholding proportion.
Do not convert the patronage principle into a fixed ratio without authority.
revisionPoints: Member shareholding as far as may be proportionate to patronage.
No fixed ratio stated in this provision's text.
